name: Dr.STOP!
source:
In "Dr. Stop", you control Takumi, who works in a hospital and whose mind is mostly occupied with female patients, most of whom are young and pretty. One day, during a visit to a patient, an explosion occurs. Who caused it - one of the patients or an outsider, or maybe a staff member? It's up to you to investigate... and to win the affection of your lovely patients.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/dr-stop]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
在《Dr.STOP!》中，玩家将操纵在医院工作的巧。他脑中大多时候想的都是女患者，而这些患者多数年轻漂亮。一天，他探望一名患者时发生爆炸。究竟是谁制造了爆炸——某位患者、外来人员，还是医院员工？真相将由你调查…与此同时，你还要赢得可爱患者们的好感。

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/dr-stop]MobyGames[/url]]
